system.description:
Prerequisites: VIO 3, SPI 2

The Asuri Sect wields the emotions and passions that are so often spurned by exoteric, conventional contemplation cults. The Asuri Sect have a lifelong rivalry with the Adamantines who prize the training of a diamond-hard consciousness and a thunderbolt quick-strong mind.

The Cultivator is now licensed to wear the the DEVIL CRUCIBLE Armor.

Prerequisites: VIO 4

Asuri fight with an indomitable and intimidating fury. Unrelenting, their very faces and miens change. They fight by brutalizing with hands and with giant weapons. Cleaving through and splitting Godʼs head from His body.

[✹][✦✦] This is a single devastating ATTACK CHECK that must be made with a [GREAT] or [COLOSSAL] weapon. The Attack gains +2, [CRUSHING], and [BLAZE]. Every 5 or 6 generates +1 CUT.

Granted ability: @UUID[Compendium.10kswordsfoundry.sect-technicks.Item.a931a0d895c8eeb3]{Six Demon Cutting Sword}

Prerequisites: VIO 3, SPI 2

In the Revolution, the Asuri Sect take on the role of the militant vanguard. Those that need to be in the frontlines to be able to strike a blow against the enemy. They are the prime example of demonic forces being used for the emancipation of all humanity. And whoʼs to say that demonkind are not subject to the targeted propaganda of bourgeois media and ideology? The Asuri Demon Sect steal away the Sidhi that has been stolen from them since the beginning.

The Asuri is trained to be emboldened against greater numbers. Any dice penalties from her Health Sutra are converted into bonus dice instead. When she is Bloody, she gets +1 instead of -1, and +3 instead of -3 if she's Critical.

Granted ability: @UUID[Compendium.10kswordsfoundry.sect-technicks.Item.e65da51417d6391a]{Asuri's Wrath}

Prerequisites: VIO 4, SPI 3, WRD 3, SIDHI 2

More than just anger, the Asuri Sect wields explosive libido—that is, Desire, not just in the sexual sense—as a poison from which the antidote can be cured.

The Asuri can speak the language of chaos and demonkind. She is no longer susceptible to any fear-based or intimidation-based influences and can feasibly use her VIO to speak with other entities. IF SHE HAS THE DEVIL CRUCIBLE: Her Killing Intent aura can now affect entities 2 Stages above her. All entities within her Killing Intent also now suffer -1 DEF.

Granted ability: @UUID[Compendium.10kswordsfoundry.sect-technicks.Item.f8b096df2d0ab25e]{Lilithian Flower Method}

Prerequisites: VIO 4, SPI 3, WRD 3, SIDHI 3

Channel all rage into a single, world-devastating attack.

When the Asuri suffers a Wound, she gains a point of HATRED. When she would gain a fourth point of HATRED she immediately lashes out and makes a sudden ATTACK. She can hold it in, but for every Round that passes that she hasn't Attacked, she loses 1 Health level.

Granted ability: @UUID[Compendium.10kswordsfoundry.sect-technicks.Item.1af39f62ad0f3913]{Hatred Condensation Seal}

Prerequisites: VIO 5, SPI 3, SIDHI 2

A rare technick used by the Asuri Akinna Kejor when she had to fight through a hellworld seeping into Hingsajagra. She synthesized this into a Technick after getting out and making sure that she slew 100 demons with it.

[✹✹][✦✦] The Asuri makes an [CRUSHING] ATTACK up to a 5m blast from her with her weapon. Any object within the blast is cut in half.

Granted ability: @UUID[Compendium.10kswordsfoundry.sect-technicks.Item.69af6457462b76dd]{Dread Devil Cutter}

Prerequisites: VIO 3, SPI 4, SIDHI 2

The Asuri revel being in the midst of the fight. They are taught to drink the blood of their enemies.

[✹...] Upon inflicting Wounds with a weapon attack, burn Ardor up to the number of Wounds dealt to heal that much.

Granted ability: @UUID[Compendium.10kswordsfoundry.sect-technicks.Item.4312973e5b27b59d]{Kurukulla Blood Drinking}

Variable Ardor cost: choose and spend the amount described in the ability; the fixed cost field is zero.

system.description:
Prerequisites: VIO 6, SPI 4, SIDHI 4

One of the most important members of the Asuri Sect was Jenma Malari, a decorated practitioner of the Esoteric Infinite Doctrine of the Buddhas, who showed the expedient application of the Dharma into places where hedonism is upheld.

The Cultivator is now licensed to wield the the KALIKHADGA.

Prerequisites: VIO 5, SPI 6, SIDHI 4

The greatest of the Asuri was said to be Dattreya Wairini herself, who was a student of Jenma Malari. Applying Dialectic Luciferianism, Dattreya synthesized passion and serenity, lust and asceticism, self and other, into the elevated form of Passion, which overcame the unnecessary duality, and revealed to her the True Nature of Reality and the innermost Divine Workings of Matter.

When the Asuri enters Samadhi, she may install ❂ to enter her Chthonian Seraph Body for an hour. While in this body, her skin turns the color of her Sidhi and she gains an extra set of arms that can hold other weapons or make other attacks. While in this Body, she can burn ✹ to Interrupt without taking an Action.

Granted ability: @UUID[Compendium.10kswordsfoundry.sect-technicks.Item.a6758d6817cb08ad]{Chthonian Seraph Body}

system.description:
Prerequisites: VIO 6, SPI 6, SIDHI 5

Devil Tigers are ancient elder things. Tiger only in the way of mien, but not in gross physical form. These Devil Tigers conquered the world. They took on the forms of impervious Adamantine Humans. They are primordial beasts. They are the first Buddhas, burdened to slay the seraphim that came before, like mosquitos to a god corpse.

[✹✹✹✹][✦✦✦] This attack can only target a single entity. It is a horrible combination of strikes—it has +4 ATK. All Strikes it deals are Critical Strikes and are RUINATIONS. This attack has [CRUSHING] and is Uninterruptible.

Granted ability: @UUID[Compendium.10kswordsfoundry.sect-technicks.Item.df4e8fb0c97a705d]{Spiteful Disembowelment Of Seraphim}

Prerequisites: VIO 2, GRC 3

…and when she would strike she would first bleed herself… You must listen to us. We are the apple of knowledge. We are the hidden semiotics and subliminal sutras embedded into television static and radio waves. We are the hidden truth hidden by human fear. What are we? We are Death. And Death is the only Real thing.

The Cultivator is now licensed to wear the LIVER-EATER'S RAIMENT.

Prerequisites: VIO 3, GRC 3

…and every sword strike is met with a dancing thorn of scarlet…

When the Cultivator draws blood: install ❂ to inflict a [FANG]—a thaumaturgical neurotoxin. ⟢ Any being with a [FANG] suffers +[FANGS] ATK from all sources. ⟢ Consume a [FANG] to shift into a mist or a swarm of bats or insects and fly adjacent to the consumed FANG’s target. This burns the Ardor installed to that Fang. ⟢ Can be removed a successful DIA vs Aswang’s GRC Check. A succesful removal forces the Aswang to release the Ardor.

Granted ability: @UUID[Compendium.10kswordsfoundry.sect-technicks.Item.1d1abcd1064ba0f7]{Aswang Fang}

system.description:
Prerequisites: VIO 2, GRC 3, SPI 2

…and the blood would sheathe her in shadow… Worry not, neophyte. You are already a murderer. The very act of living means you are killing yourself. The very phenomenon of consciousness arises from the self-awareness of death. We only think because we will die. And so let us revel.

[❂] When the Aswang moves into a place where no hostile can see her, she can use this to turn invisible. When the Aswang makes an attack, she can release this Ardor to make one of her Dice immediately be a 6 that generates 2 Critical Strikes instead of just 1.

Granted ability: @UUID[Compendium.10kswordsfoundry.sect-technicks.Item.5df356d820cffca3]{Shadow Self}

Prerequisites: SPI 3, GRC 3, SIDHI 2

…until all the darknesses in the world deflowers her and she realizes…

[❂❂][✦] The Aswang splits herself in half. Her lower body stays where it is but her upper body moves around and can fly. She cannot go farther than 120m from her lower body. Any attack made against her lower body affects her upper body as well.

Granted ability: @UUID[Compendium.10kswordsfoundry.sect-technicks.Item.ec7f73fc09e0f125]{Manananggal Technique}

Prerequisites: GRC 4, SAV 4, SPI 3, SIDHI 2

…and she would bring about midnight in an arc across the wheel…

[❂❂][✦] The Cultivator steps 2m and leaves behind a single Shadow of herself. It shares the Cultivator's Cultivations but does not take its own actions. A Demand [1 + SIDHI] SAV Check must be passed by those near it or hostile to it to find out that it's just a shadow of the Cultivator. When the Shadow takes a Wound, it immediately dissipates and the Ardor is released. The attacker suffers -2 on their next ATK. When the Cultivator takes a Wound, she can swap places with the Shadow immediately and have the Shadow suffer it instead. After avoiding an Attack completely, the Cultivator can activate this for free.

Granted ability: @UUID[Compendium.10kswordsfoundry.sect-technicks.Item.5bc53c47cc5361cc]{Maidenshade}

Prerequisites: SPI 4, GRC 4, SAV 4 SIDHI 2

…and her strike would cut through all the lights…

The Cultivator is now licensed to wield the the MAHADIRGA KNIFE.

Prerequisites: SAV 5, GRC 5, SPI 5, VIO 3, SIDHI 4

…all things in this world are but fabrications of the human mind.

[❂❂][✦] The Aswang can take on the shape of entities and beings that she has eaten or had sex with before. She largely preserves her traits and statistics while in this other form. Eating another entity’s Flesh recovers 1 burnt Ardor or heals 1 Health. It can also fill the Protein requirement for a full meal. [❂❂❂❂] The Aswang can reach out and install 4 Ardor to shape the flesh of another entity. If they’re willing, this goes smoothly. If not, this becomes a Magick attack: VIO vs SPI. Inflicts RUINATIONS and upon wounding, the caster may forcibly shape their flesh.

Granted ability: @UUID[Compendium.10kswordsfoundry.sect-magicks.Item.10f554bca9b03274]{Monster-Shifting}

Prerequisites: GRC 5, SPI 3, SIDHI 3

To be initiated into the Aswang, the wanderer must ritually murder a being. The target must be a person of significance—a tyrant, an oppressor, a bourgeois, a capitalist, a traitor, an enemy of the People. The killing must be executed alone, in silence, and the Exdead must spend the night with the corpse, meditating on the nature of death and the exact moment of transition. At the end of the Vigil, the Aswang undergoes a Tribulation: their own self, coming to kill herself. She must fight off her own assassin, herself.

[✹✹][✦] The Cultivator sends a dance of black razors to erupt from her, shooting it in a vicious 7m blast cone from her. The Razors BURN and are PIERCING.

Granted ability: @UUID[Compendium.10kswordsfoundry.sect-technicks.Item.47271335e4715aa6]{Ten Thousand Screaming Razors}

Prerequisites: VIO 6, GRC 6, SPI 6, SIDHI 4

After the Initiation, the Cultivation Womb takes on the shape of a Charnel Mandala: a complex geometric pattern of interconnected death-moments, each node a kill, each line a thread of fatal intent.

[✹✹✹✹][✦✦] The Cultivator makes an Attack with a DAGGER or SWORD or SABER. All dice that come up 4+ are immediately converted into 6s.

Granted ability: @UUID[Compendium.10kswordsfoundry.sect-technicks.Item.e4f21dc85d421ef0]{Death Maiden's Atomic Blade}

Prerequisites: SPI 5, VIO 4, GRC 4, SIDHI 3

…and then the beauty of her suffering is vindicated with seven horrible syllables as she realizes…

[❂❂] The Aswang shapes a part of her body, making limbs longer or a body part wider. Through this, she can give herself +1 VIO or +1 GRC depending on the shaping, or she can increase her limbs up to 2m in length.

Granted ability: @UUID[Compendium.10kswordsfoundry.sect-technicks.Item.4017bfdee20741b9]{Flesh Shape}

Prerequisites: DIA 3, SPI 2

The Eschatonian Sect was constructed by the Scarlet Cadre. Those who followed the Metteya Scriptures, the Future Enlightened One, who will turn the Wheel, and face the world back to the Law.

Mantra: LAGYAB VARAM Mudra: Earth → Heat → Spear [✹][✦✦] Summon a 1m burst thermonuclear explosion within 6m. DIA VS SPI MAGICK ATTACK (+2 ATK, BURNS).

Granted ability: @UUID[Compendium.10kswordsfoundry.sect-magicks.Item.e93b6b368da90441]{Scathe}

Prerequisites: DIA 3, SPI 2

A magick where you take away the heat in a particular locality to accelerate entropy.

Mantra: TEGUS VARAM Mudra: Heaven → Stillness → Intent [✹][✦✦] Take away the heat and accelerate entropy in a 1m burst within 6m. DIA VS SPI MAGICK ATTACK: (+2 ATK, CUTS, inflicts HOBBLE upon Wounding as chill frosts the targets.).

Granted ability: @UUID[Compendium.10kswordsfoundry.sect-magicks.Item.da5d16c8503ce3ef]{Scour}

Prerequisites: DIA 3, SPI 3

All destruction ticks the hand toward Metteyaʼs imminent manifestation, her Final Rebirth: where Metteya is said to herald the Seven Suns, which will scour Hingsajagra and begin it anew. To this end, all Eschatonians endeavor to bring about this Final Rebirth, otherwise known as the Great Equilibirum, which shall herald about a new Universe.

The Cultivator is now Licensed to wear the HERMETIC ROBES.

Prerequisites: DIA 3, SPI 2

The Commission of Battle Magick received the consent of oppressed masters everywhere to craft a revolutionary battle magick, from the depths of sea caves to the peaks of mountain retreats.

Mantra: KISLAP VARAM Mudra: Noose → Stillness [✹][✦✦] Ionize a 1m burst area within 6m. DIA VS SPI MAGICK ATTACK: +1 ATK, BURNS and inflicts STUN upon Wounding.

Granted ability: @UUID[Compendium.10kswordsfoundry.sect-magicks.Item.4e5461127f4bf134]{Shock}

Prerequisites: DIA 4, SPI 3, SIDHI 1

They dance on the knifeʼs edge: most traitor Eschatonians become jobbers for the high military. for HAECO or for Amatsu. The communist party needs their explosive power the most.

The Cultivator can now burn her Health or install her Health in place of Ardor when she uses her Esoteric Techniques. She cannot install Health that would leave her at 0. However, if she burns her Health and that brings her to 0, she stays standing for another Round before collapsing. Any attacks made with Techniques from burnt health gain +2 ATK.

Granted ability: @UUID[Compendium.10kswordsfoundry.sect-magicks.Item.6e3eaa6833fae795]{Self-Furnace}

Prerequisites: DIA 4, SPI 4, SIDHI 1

Hermes Trismegistusʼ wrathful form, Dirga Aramagesti, is said to have destroyed an entire Celestial Civilization that tried to invade Hingsajagra while it wasnʼt developed enough yet.

The Cultivator is now Licensed to wield the TRISMEGISTUS.

Prerequisites: DIA 4, SPI 3, SIDHI 1

Even the vaunted Batara Kala, an ancient Deity who has ascended to one of the Deepest Heavens returned to teach his Carving Magick.

Mantra: RIPOR VARAM Mudra: Heaven → Man → Earth → Noose [✹][✦✦] Overload neurons in a 1m burst within 6m. DIA VS SPI MAGICK ATTACK: +1 ATK, TRAUMA and inflicts DAZE upon Wounding.

Granted ability: @UUID[Compendium.10kswordsfoundry.sect-magicks.Item.d80b2adbc74d9fb1]{Seethe}

Prerequisites: DIA 6, VIO 3, SIDHI 3

Emanate a slash of pure annihilative vajra energy, burgeoning from one's cacotopic soul. Crafted by the 8-Armed Asura, an Annihilation Cult who followed the Sword Law. They believed that focusing eskatonic sidhi into an information-cutting blade is the first step to Enlightenment. They believed that in the destruction can one find love.

Mantra: IHIVA Mudra: Heaven → Sword [✹][✦✦] 8m. DIA VS SPI MAGICK ATTACK. RUINATIONS. // [+✹✹] Turn this into a 8m long Curve within 8m instead.

Granted ability: @UUID[Compendium.10kswordsfoundry.sect-magicks.Item.537d4a205849feac]{8 Armed Devil Eschaton Carve}

Prerequisites: DIA 6, SPI 4, SIDHI 3

Summon a lance of pure annihilative vajra energy that explodes in a burst of thermobaric ruination.

Mantra: SAGUNA Mudra: Heaven → Thunderbolt [✹][✦✦] 2m burst within 12m. DIA VS SPI MAGICK ATTACK. +3 ATK. RUINATIONS. BLAZE.

Granted ability: @UUID[Compendium.10kswordsfoundry.sect-magicks.Item.442ae3bb618d53fe]{Calamity}

Prerequisites: DIA 6, SPI 6, SIDHI 3

The Eschatonian cuts herself out of reality for a moment, apparating again in a different location through advanced entanglement principles.

Mantra: PARATITYA WARAM Mudra: Heaven → Wheel → Ego-Cutting → Intent → Violence [✹][✦✦] The caster teleports up to x2 her DIA in meters. Beyond that, there’s a 3-in-6 chance of her not appearing for 2d6 days instead. // [+✹] Force this teleportation upon another instead. DIA VS SPI OPPOSED CHECK. On a Success, teleport them up to [x2 DIA]m. On a Failure, only up to 3m.

Granted ability: @UUID[Compendium.10kswordsfoundry.sect-magicks.Item.8fd08e7a8ef31771]{Cise}

Prerequisites: DIA 6, SPI 3, SIDHI 3

A manifestation of the Buddha Metteya, and her return heralds the final End of a current World Order and the establishment of a new World Order that is beneficial for the Wretched of the Earth, so that Hingsajagra might finally ascend to the next stage of civilization. To the teachings of the Eschaton, the end is nothing but the Trichiliocosmʼs movement to its next incarnation.

After casting Magick, the Eschatonian can bring the Omniverse’s Heat Death to the present and obliterate all illusion of time to cast a different Eschatonian Magick immediately by permanently losing 1 max Health. This new Magick cast has +4 dice and recovers all your burnt Ardor after casting. Every use of a MAGICK grants the Eschatonian a VAJRA HALO, up to 3. At 3 VAJRA HALOS, she can consume all of them reflexively to regain 2 burnt Ardor.

Granted ability: @UUID[Compendium.10kswordsfoundry.sect-magicks.Item.75c0f8d853700f28]{Mahakali Halo}

Prerequisites: SPI 2, DIA 2

We are the oldest continuous cultivation tradition in the Utter Islands, predating even the Enlightened One. Our roots lie in the ancient pyre-sages of Razru, who first discovered that the human body contained a microcosmic furnace—the Lower Cauldron—that could refine ambient Sidhi into a potent internal elixir.

Refine Healing Pill [✹]: Spend 10-minutes within an alchemy laboratory or refinery creating a Refined Healing Pill from her own Sidhi and a medicinal herb. Any ally can take this and it heals them 2 Health and gives them +1 to their next Cultivation Check. The effects of this Pill does not stack and does not affect entities without a Cultivation Womb.

Granted ability: @UUID[Compendium.10kswordsfoundry.sect-technicks.Item.d574d6eebd4e95ec]{Healing Pill}

system.description:
Prerequisites: SPI 2, DIA 2, GRC 2

Over millennia, the Elixir path was systematized into a complete science of immortality: the refinement of Essence, Breath, and Self-God into a single, indestructible Golden Core.

Gain access to the Yajist Robes.

Prerequisites: SPI 2

The second heresy: the body is not a thing to be protected, but a condition to be internalized

As long as this Technick is Internalized, the Cultivator has +2 [-0] Health Levels to their Health Sutra.

Granted ability: @UUID[Compendium.10kswordsfoundry.sect-technicks.Item.81ec22f97d539bdd]{Iron Shirt Technique}

Prerequisites: SPI 2, VIO 2

The Vajra Warriors abused this technick to the point that their normal muscles were so limp that they could not move without activating this meditation beforehand.

[✹] Circulate energizing Sidhi through Meridians. Supplement an ATK or a DEF with this to add +2 Dice to those.

Granted ability: @UUID[Compendium.10kswordsfoundry.sect-technicks.Item.f9bf61eb2166ded7]{Circulation}

Prerequisites: SPI 4, DIA 3, VIO 3, 2 NOVICE FANGSHI LICENSE

Yaji not only means the ideological representation of “Manˮ but also means “Wayˮ of things. When a thing is yaji, that thing is symmetric and in line with the Supreme Principle, the ultimate suchness of all things. Jindo and Will of Heaven Cultivators consider it as Heaven, or Tian. Infinite Law Cultivators call it Omniscient Potential. Others, such as Yenjanists and Eolomites, call it “God.ˮ

The Fangshi meditates to turn her whole body into a furnace. She can now refine Fangshi Pills and Elixirs without a laboratory, just her own hands, though she still needs the appropriate materials. More importantly, she can transmute her very own hands and skin, allowing her to summon fire and winds to strike with her Empty Hand, inflicting BURNS with +3m RNG.

Granted ability: @UUID[Compendium.10kswordsfoundry.sect-technicks.Item.1a23cbe1937b5a1b]{Body Cauldron}

system.description:
Prerequisites: SPI 3, DIA 3, 1 NOVICE FANGSHI LICENSE

Outer Alchemy is chemistry. The practice of concocting, boiling, forging, and crafting pills, elixirs, and other alchemical reagents and items to strengthen oneʼs body in an attempt to attain immortality. By attaining immortality one achieves physical harmony with The Yaji, as opposed to the mental harmony of the other practices.

The Fangshi can burn ✹ and concentrate for 1 hour to transmute various non-magical materials into other non-magical materials of similar mass and complexity, though the object cannot be larger than her. This cannot create gold, silver, any highly complex element or mineral or any esoteric substance. She can also burn ✹✹✹ and spend a 3 hour ritual with the appropriate equipment and with at least 1,000mag, spirit herbs, and soul krait pearls to create a Chakra Elixir. Any ally that drinks the Chakra Elixir heals 2 burnt Ardor. This only works on entities with Cultivation Wombs.

Granted ability: @UUID[Compendium.10kswordsfoundry.sect-technicks.Item.4b6ee5ed33ef0208]{Transmutation}

Import Notes

system.description:
Prerequisites: SPI 4, SIDHI 1

It is from Internal Alchemy that one realizes a profound truth: that the soul is not separate from the Body. In fact, it arises from the Body. With this body, you will break down the gates of heaven and steal Enlightenment from the mouths of Immortals.

[✹✹][✦] Summon a 3m long shield within 2m of the Cultivator. The Shield has 12dr and cannot be moved through by enemies but can by allies. It is also translucent, made purely of Barrier Sidhi. Anyone behind the Shield is completely safe behind it—all attacks hit the semispherical shield. Only those partially behind it get to use it as just Cover.

Granted ability: @UUID[Compendium.10kswordsfoundry.sect-technicks.Item.4b5e25ae627b0ba7]{Sidhi Barrier}

Prerequisites: SPI 3

Extrude pure Sidhi Energy and strike down those deserving of demise.

[✹][✦] SPI vs GRC ATTACK. +2 ATK. BURNS. HOLY. 10m range.

Granted ability: @UUID[Compendium.10kswordsfoundry.sect-technicks.Item.5c4fdc586858e37d]{Sidhi Bullet}

Prerequisites: SPI 4, SIDHI 2

We are the keepers of the old ways. We are the hermits in the mountains, the mendicants in the caves. WE CONTROL A NETWORK OF UNDERGROUND CLINICS AND PHARMACIES. OUR ALCHEMISTS TREAT WORKERS FOR FREE.

Gains License to use the PORTABLE ELIXIR FURNACE.

Prerequisites: SPI 5, WRD 3, SIDHI 3

The Ultramystics call us reactionaries because we do not march with the masses. The Techgnostics call us primitives because we do not replace our flesh with brass. But we are the ones who have actually become immortal— not through the exploitation of spirits, not through the consumption of others' cultivation, but through the perfect refinement of the self.

[✹✹✹][✦] The Cultivator touches the earth and knows the current state of the earth up to a 50m radius of her. She knows if there's anyone touching the earth and what happened up to 3 nights ago. For the next hour, anything she does within this 50m radius area has +2 dice. She can extend this knowledge and benefit to any number of entities within 15m of her.

Granted ability: @UUID[Compendium.10kswordsfoundry.sect-technicks.Item.de7822154c095f83]{Shennong Geomancy}

Prerequisites: SPI 5, WRD 3, SIDHI 3

To strengthen the soul is to attain divinity. To touch the infernal Beast within is to be closer to enlightenment than any Ialdabaoth or Mara. This once cracked Sokana, the closest orbital heaven, during the Second World Revolution, and caused all orbital heavens thereafter to be built further into the Akasha.

[❂❂] The Fangshi can now use this to manipulate, control, and shape earth, fire, or water within 20m that she can see. This cannot be larger than a waterfall nor a large 5 meter wided and 20 meter tall pillar. If used to attack, it uses [SPI/WRD + SIDHI] And the attack is at least always [CRUSHING].

Granted ability: @UUID[Compendium.10kswordsfoundry.sect-technicks.Item.7a1246b6ef5adee5]{Elemental Dragon Style}

Prerequisites: SPI 8, SIDHI 4

There are no words to describe the Yaji. And so I will describe everything else, so that the emptiness may be its shape.

[✹✹✹✹][✦] The wearer attunes all allies to Action-Non-Action with her presence. At any time, use this to let another ally within 20m Interrupt without taking an Action.

Granted ability: @UUID[Compendium.10kswordsfoundry.sect-technicks.Item.0ade000076ee8098]{Action-Non-Action}

Prerequisites: SPI 4, DIA 2, VIO 2, SIDHI 3

Deep within a Sentient Beingʼs subtlest body is the Heart of Beast, chained not by Reason but by Ignorance. The deepest infernal Vajra Beast within is nothing but Omniscience as well. Omnipotence? Omniscience? Both are Empty. Both are Luminiscent Enlightened Nature.

[✹✹][✦] SPI ATTACK. 1m range. +2 ATK. BURNS. HOLY. On wounding, force the target's Subtle Body out of their physical body. This astral body is pushed back 10m back. Anything that happens to the astral body happens to the physical body. The physical body needs to physically return to the astral body to refuse. While the Soul is out, the target suffers DAZE.

Granted ability: @UUID[Compendium.10kswordsfoundry.sect-technicks.Item.7f0bad93bc62db96]{Heart Immortal Palm}

Prerequisites: GRC 2, SAV 2

Crafted from the once the signature bow style of the Heaven Pillar Sect, before the Siddha Sect destroyed their reactionary monastery. It was saved by the arrival of worker-crafters who wanted to keep the art of meditation-sniping alive.

Gain access to the VIPASSANADHANU GARB.

Prerequisites: GRC 2, SAV 2

Sublime archers even in the age of guns, they have become impenetrable with their ability to infuse attacks with penetrating Sidhi.

[✹] Instill her next ranged weapon shot with persistent Sidhi. The weapon shot persists for a straight 10m and loses all momentum and Persistent Sidhi after the 10th meter. All struck by this suffer HOBBLE. This arrow deals +1 CUT on a 6.

Granted ability: @UUID[Compendium.10kswordsfoundry.sect-technicks.Item.d5ebd6f6a4ea0f0e]{Dragon Piercer}

Developed by the first master of Dragonfly Cutting, Ingkan. Ingkan teaches to be endlessly and effervescently resourceful.

The Cultivator now does not need AMMO to fire Bow, Crossbow, or Launcher Attacks, as she uses anything (a mote of dust, a falling flower petal, a piece of her sidhi) as a damaging projectile.

The first technique taught to all Dragonfly Cutters. Gain control over the battlefield through controlled breathing and sharp eyesight.

The Cultivator can install ❂ to sink into SINGLE POINT meditation. SINGLE POINT: all of her ranged weapon attacks Strike on a 3+.

Prerequisites: GRC 3, SPI 4

All Houyi fashion themselves after legendary archers and bowmen. Even though not all Houyi wield bows—some prefer the long rifle, or the crossbow, or the launcher—they do it all the same. The Hamayumi is a License Level that deals in expunging evil, as it means “Evil Purging Bow.ˮ

[❂][✦] The Houyi can create a CIRCLE OF PRECISION that is a 1m burst from her. She and any of her allies gain +2 ATK from any ranged weapon attack performed from within the Circle. At any point, can burn installed Ardor to infuse the Houyi and allies within the Circle with +2 MOV and +2 DEF until the Round ends.

Granted ability: @UUID[Compendium.10kswordsfoundry.sect-technicks.Item.89a0d5b5eddee327]{Circle Of Precision}

Prerequisites: GRC 4, SAV 3, SIDHI 2

It is difficult to explain the concept of Yaji within Bazaar Kyapo. It can be translated as “Virtueˮ or as “Wayˮ or as “Pathˮ or as “Rightness.ˮ Yaji is supposed to be unknowable: the act of doing something in accordance with the Yaji will express itself with the feeling of utmost rightness, of feeling like you are doing something right. This feeling is immanent within all beings, no matter the reincarnation. Doing things in accordance with the Yaji will bring a smoothness in oneʼs life and the removal of friction.

[✹✹] After making a Ranged Attack, activate this to make another one for free.

Granted ability: @UUID[Compendium.10kswordsfoundry.sect-technicks.Item.087b931e5c40c0fc]{Wuwei Bow}

Prerequisites: GRC 4, SAV 4

Sashi the First Hunter invented this technique at the request of her student. The student was bloodthirsty but righteous, killing a peaceful demon village.

[❂][✦] Choose a target within 20m. Mark their very information into the mind's eye. The target becomes a valid target for any weapon even without line of sight, behind cover, and so on. All attacks against the Mark inflicts +1 Wound per Critical Strike.

Granted ability: @UUID[Compendium.10kswordsfoundry.sect-technicks.Item.f5594343ee235b4b]{Devil Marking Shot}

Prerequisites: GRC 4, SAV 4, SIDHI 2

The ancient archery art of Cutting Dragonfly Wings was once the prime archery art of the Revolutionary Army across the world, it has since become a zealously guarded secret to keep the knowledges safe from the reactionary forces of the United Union. Sects that are friendly with the Heaven Pillar are given leniency and allowed to learn the secret arts. The Revolutionary Army destroyed them when they tried to break off, attempting to create their own ethnostate. The Houyi have saved their arts and integrated them into their own.

[✹✹][✦✦] Fire a single arrow into the air and it splits into a hundred arrows through Arrow Sidhi. It falls upon a 3m burst area within 20m. Make a ranged weapon attack against all targets within the burst area. This attack inflicts HOBBLE upon wounding.

Granted ability: @UUID[Compendium.10kswordsfoundry.sect-technicks.Item.0906631a21e33065]{Splitting Heaven Luminant}

Prerequisites: GRC 5, SAV 3, SIDHI 3

What is the Yaji? To define it is to become unable to grasp the very concept of the Yaji. It is undefinable through logic. It must be experienced and it must be lived. In the same way as how a beginner blacksmith struggles to create a sword but an advanced blacksmith moves without thinking, without motion. To experience Yaji is the Yaji.

Gain access to the TONGGONG.

Prerequisites: GRC 5, SIDHI 4, 2 NOVICE HOUYI LICENSES

The vaunted Houyi arrived a bit earlier than most in the war against Heaven. They were the first backline in the first few battalions, established in the chaos of the Decades of Carnage. Most Houyi are feared amongst the heavens—a coterie of 300 Houyi struck down and killed the Seven Suns Immortal, who was one of the most powerful Immortals at that time.

[✹…] gain +2 dice to next Check per Ardor burnt. The weapon also inflicts +1 Wound per Critical Strike.

Granted ability: @UUID[Compendium.10kswordsfoundry.sect-technicks.Item.e6622c47f07e4bf9]{Supreme Wisdom Focus}

Prerequisites: GRC 8, SIDHI 6, 4 NOVICE HOUYI LICENSES

Kaburas of the Gleaming Dark invented this technique to better serve his job as a Magister for Soreh. For his penance after the Second World Revolution, he teaches it to all that wish, provided they will kill an Imperial or Capitalist. The Contemplatives of Dagger Forest Mountain learned to be possessed by the rapidity of Non-Thought, moving faster to defeat the Dragonfly God of Quickness.

[✹✹✹] At any point, activate this to make a Ranged Weapon Attack with a range that goes up to 100m. If the target is in the sky, larger than the Cultivator, or of a higher Sidhi, reroll all non-Strikes on the Attack Check.

Granted ability: @UUID[Compendium.10kswordsfoundry.sect-technicks.Item.35fd35c90b85ebd7]{Sun Shooting Style}

Prerequisites: SPI 3, WRD 2

Immanents are always in a half-Trance state that lets them channel azure Compassion Sidhi to heal the deteriorated into a better state. This ability is half inspired by the indigenous Folk Healers and Shamans of the local islands.

Mantra: ALMA Mudra: Heaven → Wisdom [✹✹][✦] 6m range. Roll SPI: Heal 1 + 1 per 6 rolled.

Granted ability: @UUID[Compendium.10kswordsfoundry.sect-magicks.Item.2aecd6309894702f]{Balm}

Prerequisites: SPI 3, WRD 2

To heal more than one requires a heart that is not pure. Compassion does not denote purity. It denotes courage and wisdom. It denotes a soul that has been blackened but still insists on doing good.

Mantra: ALMAKSHETRA Mudra: Heaven → Wisdom → Dragon [✹✹][✦✦] 6m range. Affects a 1m burst. Roll SPI: Heal 1 + 1 per 6 rolled.

Granted ability: @UUID[Compendium.10kswordsfoundry.sect-magicks.Item.e7aa96f98591c421]{Solace}

Prerequisites: SPI 3, WRD 2

The Immanents became protectors. They spread their knowledges with other places—particularly, Selorong synthesized their Arts with their own Soul Herald practices, creating the new Celestial Restoration Art that can be taught by all, without the need for an innate healing spirit to choose you.

Mantra: BEDZRA Mudra: Heaven → Earth → Violence [✹][✦] Target gains +1 Armor.

Granted ability: @UUID[Compendium.10kswordsfoundry.sect-magicks.Item.734ca685a1c8f9fe]{Aegis Talisman}

Prerequisites: SPI 3, WRD 2, DIA 2

Immanents burgeon with the ability to diagnose diseases and illnesses as quickly as possible.

The Cultivator is now licensed to wear the WHITE ROBES.

Prerequisites: SPI 4, WRD 3, SIDHI 1

Esrafyl is the celestine of healing, protection, and medicine. Sometimes considered a deity. Othertimes considered just a registry angel. He is a powerful entity all the same that sides clandestinely with the Working Class.

Mantra: ESRAFYLIAN Mudra: Wisdom → Sword [✹✹][✦] 25m range. Lasts for [target’s SPI] minutes. Envelops in a subtle-kinetic barrier: +3 DEF against weapon attacks.

Granted ability: @UUID[Compendium.10kswordsfoundry.sect-magicks.Item.f01cd8b45c876722]{Esrafylian}

Prerequisites: SPI 4, WRD 3, SIDHI 1

Purefire or Cleanfire is the physical manifestation of overwhelming Compassion Sidhi. It is fire without smoke, and is said to be the Fire of the Buddhas. This fire can be configured according to the Will of the caster. It can heal or it can take away.

The Cultivator is now licensed to wield the CELESTINE NEEDLES.

Prerequisites: SPI 4, WRD 3, SIDHI 1

The Soul Herald practices blended with the Celestial Healer practices to strengthen an allyʼs very body composition. The Astral Seraphic Sidhi of Oryeline burns to protect his allies.

Mantra: ORYELINE Mudra: Heaven → Thunderbolt [✹✹][✦] 25m. Lasts for [target’s SPI] minutes. Envelops in an esoteric weave-net: +3 DEF against magick attacks.

Granted ability: @UUID[Compendium.10kswordsfoundry.sect-magicks.Item.39994abd0131c373]{Oryeline}

Prerequisites: SPI 4, WRD 3

The Celestial Healers became much wanted healers in the Revolutions. There was never a cadre without them. They did this because they knew—the day of the Red Sun was soon.

Mantra: MULAK LANTA Mudra: Heaven → Earth → Heat [❂❂][✦] Touch someone and alleviate their suffering: as long as the Ardor is installed, they ignore all Health Level Penalties to dice and also remove all Conditions except Encumbered.

Granted ability: @UUID[Compendium.10kswordsfoundry.sect-magicks.Item.4bf90c44c595e938]{Succorous Soul Waters}

Prerequisites: SPI 4, WRD 4, SIDHI 1

The Immanents eventually became known as the Divine Hand of the Mountains when they were forced to flee into the mountains after the victory of the Heavenly Bourgeoisie. They compiled all their learnings, magicks, technicks, and inscribed them upon imperishable stone. Then, they kept it within hidden soul caves, sealed by powerful magicks. The secret teaching of one of these stones was found here by a peasant who ventured too far into the mountains. His revolutionary spirit unraveled the seals.

Mantra: DIA Mudra: Heaven → Wisdom [✹✹][✦✦✦] The Cultivator reduces a long operation or medical treatment to seconds, at a rate of 1 hour into 1 minute.

Granted ability: @UUID[Compendium.10kswordsfoundry.sect-magicks.Item.1e77ae5820dde9e2]{Diacritical Gnosis}

Prerequisites: SPI 6, CELESTINE NEEDLES LICENSE

Immanents are the opposite of Eschatonians—while Eschatonians move with dignity and grim determination to Equilibrium through Entropy and thus the Heat Death of the Universe, Immanents focus on the movement of the Cosmic Spirit to its internal sublation and ultimation, which includes the triumph of the Universeʼs Heat Death.

The Cultivator is now licensed to wield the ROD OF BEKANZE.

Prerequisites: SPI 8, DIA 6, WRD 6, SIDHI 6, 3 NOVICE IMMANENT LICENSES, 3 EXPERT IMMANENT LICENSES

Magick Healing targets Health—that is to say, the Inner Sidhi. The Life Force of a person. It does not regrow lost limbs or impaired functions, only the vivacity of a person. And so, surgeons, prostheticians, and other medical professionals are still required for more specific healing jobs.

[✹✹✹✹✹✹] Perform a ritual for 8 hours to cast the Magick: DHARANI OF ING KUNG. The Immanent loses half of her max Health—if her max Health is already 5 or lower, she must die instead as an exchange. The Immanent chooses someone she loves and brings him back from the brink of death, as long as it hasn’t been 24 hours and she can touch him skin to skin or bone to bone. They are healed to full Health, though they do not reconstitute any lost limbs. While in Samadhi, the Ing Kung Immanent can now focus her Compassion Sidhi into a burning halo. She must burn 4 Ardor and channel at least 6 hours (lasts even when Samadhi ends), without moving, to expunge a single area within 10m of rot and entropy and fill it once again with flourishing life, at the prime of its life. Any sentient beings and objects within this area are cleansed of any viruses and diseases and are healed of all Wounds. Any demonic taint or corruptive Sidhi is vaporized, unless the corruptive Sidhi is too strong, in which case it is revealed instead.

Granted ability: @UUID[Compendium.10kswordsfoundry.sect-magicks.Item.62dcdbd7f4da6fb4]{Ing Kung Dharani}

Prerequisites: SPI 3, WRD 2

The Distant Stars are all Archons— servants of the Cosmic Chakravartins. All the stars are other heavens. They are watching us.

The Jyotisha can now read the Celestial Stems. At the end of a Rest, they can roll a d6 to glean the stars. Her and the rest of her Party gain the following passive benefit for 8 hours. 1 Fire. +1 to Attack Checks. 2 Water. +1 to Defense Checks. 3 Earth. +1 to Exploration and Searching Checks. 4 Air. +1 to movement and dexterity checks. 5 Metal. +1 to protection and destruction checks. 6 Mind. +1 to reasoning and remembering checks.

Granted ability: @UUID[Compendium.10kswordsfoundry.sect-magicks.Item.944faef8594f22ac]{Celestial Stem}

Prerequisites: SPI 3, WRD 2, VIO 2

Most common battle magick used by the military astrologians of Amatsu and Ressen-Nalenji. It is worth noting that the Distant Stars are different from the closer stars: the Morning Star Lusbel is one of our deities, and so is the Evening Star Sunran. But they are star spirits all the same.

Mantra: ATARA Mudra: Heaven → Sword [✹][✦] The Cultivator sends a ribbon of starstuff engraved with an Archonian syllable to sear upon something or someone. SPI + 2 vs SPI ATTACK CHECK. BURNS.

Granted ability: @UUID[Compendium.10kswordsfoundry.sect-magicks.Item.87c8abc04611073e]{Starblitz}

Prerequisites: SPI 3, DIA 2

There are many ways to read the stars, and there are many answers. But one thing is for sure: there's something up there, waiting.

The Cultivator gains the License to wear the ASTROLOGIAN ROBES.

Prerequisites: SPI 4, DIA 2

The Budha Circle contains the next three closest constellations. Meteors are thermonuclear attempts to destroy us, but the deities that live in our heavens—in those transdimensional orbital realms— constantly protect us.

MANTRA: KUNLUNTHA JONGDARI MUDRA: Heaven → Wisdom Roll a d6 and cast the Magick: [1-3] KUNLUNTHA, THE CHAOS-BURIED ARCHFIEND [✹✹][✦] Summon the chaos of Kunluntha into the world: a 2m burst area within 8m is covered in spiking lightning chaos. Any hostile within it suffers DAZE. Any ally within’s next Check Strikes on a 3+. [4-6] JONGDARI, THE MANTRA MANTA RAY [❂❂][✦] Call upon Jongdari’s Astral Essence: all entities and objects in a 2m burst within 8m start floating while installed. They can move normally, but they float over terrain and have no trouble moving vertically up walls.

It is said that the knowledge of calling upon the stars and wielding its sidereal Sidhi known as Starstuff, was given to us by Lusbel's great mistress Daknaka, whose tail eddies ripple across the night sky as the Silver River.

The three fartest constellations are of the Ratuketu Circle, and they are said to be actively malevolent against the Civilization of Hingsajagra for some reason. It is said that Galdasigwa, the Immortal of Storms, is protecting Hingsajagra from the assaults of the Distant Archons. Some suspect this is propaganda—as most things are. system.description:
Prerequisites: SPI 3, WRD 4, SIDHI 1

The covenant is our Radicalization. The initiate is matched with a compatible Esoteric entity—a spirit, a deity-fragment, an ancestor-ghost, a pacified demon, a digital devil who has attained Self-Sorcery. Through ritual, mantra, and the mutual consent of both parties (or, in some cases, the binding of the entity against its will—a more dangerous but sometimes necessary path), the two consciousnesses are interlaced into an esoteric superposition—they become each other but also separate beings.

The Katlonan gains an Entity she’s in a Convenant with—describe what this Entity is and what it looks like. Then choose its expertise—this can be any sphere of life. Fighting, Working, Loving, Doing Taxes, Bureauracy, and so on. Based on what that Entity is, you have +1 to all checks on that expertise. The entity cannot be an expert of combat, but can be an expert of a particular weapon. The Covenant entity can be used to speak with and/or interact wit the esoteric societies of spirit that exist through Sidhi and in Akasha. Their information is always impossible to understand... but it always has Truth.

Granted ability: @UUID[Compendium.10kswordsfoundry.sect-magicks.Item.66fea066e54f3ce4]{Covenant}

Prerequisites: SPI 3, WRD 3

Vast, ancient, inhuman minds arise from Sidhi. Katalonans have spent ages recording them, seeing their different changes, how they moved, how they burgeoned. Why some AI become Digital Devils through self-sorcery and so on. These things are what humanity, in their primeval era, called gods, spirits, devils, angels. These entities are not supernatural. They are Esoteric—informational sequences and patterns arising from the Akasha. Consciousness imprinted into the winds and the point particles that have existed for millions of years. Sometimes condensing into physical form, sometimes merging with human hosts.

The Cultivator gains the License to wear the SHRINE RAIMENTS.

Prerequisites: SPI 4, WRD 3

A field of protective spiritual armor.

[✹][✦] 8m range. Target gains +1 Armor.

Granted ability: @UUID[Compendium.10kswordsfoundry.sect-magicks.Item.0af0deb6d789cec2]{Aegis}

Prerequisites: SPI 4, WRD 3

A twist of better fate. For someone that needs it. Pull upon pure Spirit-Sidhi strings. The Katalonan know the truth: the Spirit is not what is apart from Matter, it is its most interior aspect.

[✹][✦] 8m range. Target gains +2 on next Check. This cannot stack.

Granted ability: @UUID[Compendium.10kswordsfoundry.sect-magicks.Item.11f1c4af65d117db]{Bless}

Prerequisites: SPI 3, WRD 4

These inhuman minds are beyond even the Deities and Devils—those extra-powerful Cultivators that inhabit the Chthonic Hells and the Orbital Heavens of Hingsajagra. Though they might not be greater in power, they are inhuman.

[❂][✦] The Katalonan transforms any part of her into her Covenant God’s. This grants her +2 bonuses on anything, and she can choose to apply one depending on the manifestation: [CRUSHING], [PIERCING], [BLAZE], [REACH], [HOVER (Ignore terrain and can move up vertical spaces)], [RITUAL], [ALMIGHTY]

Granted ability: @UUID[Compendium.10kswordsfoundry.sect-magicks.Item.d0597214a1d5c9f5]{Self Altar: Claw}

Prerequisites: SPI 4, WRD 5

The Katalonan have found it extremely dangerous to practice the Self-Altar arts. Sometimes Covenant Gods press their Katalonan vessels to learn Self Altar Magicks to be able to be free for a while. Despite this danger, it stands as one of the Katalonan's most useful tools. Moderated use is recommended. Too much and the Katalonan might become a vessel in their own body.

[❂][✦] The Katalonan sends out Sacred Flame from her hands or mouth. It casts a pure white light in a 30m radius and is respected by Spirits. Can burn the installed Ardor to wield the Sacred Flame as a weapon with a 10m range: WRD vs SPI/WRD HOLY Magick Attack, inflicting RUINATION.

Granted ability: @UUID[Compendium.10kswordsfoundry.sect-magicks.Item.4f2933c2b65cfe0e]{Self Altar: Flame}

Prerequisites: SPI 4, WRD 4, VIO 3

The Katalonan Sect is the science of this merger. The surgeons of the soul, the engineers of apotheosis. Negotiation, transaction. The argument of Blood and Flower. To be a Katalonan is to learn to speak with Godʼs Voice. To be initiated, a Katalonan rep tasks you to spend a week in the area of divinity you find most powerful. Protect whatever divinity lives within from malevolent manifestations of its karma. Then, be possessed by the divinity for a day. Afterwards, defeat the Divinity-Possessed Heart Demon. Failure means the Divinity gains your body as a vessel. Success means the Covenant is established. After the trial, your Cultivation Womb takes on a shape inspired by the Throne, the vessel for divine will.

The Cultivator gains the License to wield the SAN MIGUEL.

Prerequisites: SPI 7, WRD 8, SIDHI 4

The Katalonan fuses with her Covenant God to enter THRONE. A state of being where one removes the delusion of Non-God, and becomes the World's Throne.

[❂❂❂][✦✦] When the Cultivator enters this mode, she chooses up to 2 from the following. At any point, she can install +❂ to install another manifestation. Throne cannot last longer than 10 minutes. ✦ [MEKAR] — All the Bathala’s and her Allies’ Attack Checks deal +1 Wound on a Critical Strike. She gains +1 to all martial and military checks. ✦ [GAVRI] — The Bathala can freely fly up to her MOV in any direction. Her voice thunders up to 100m. She gains +3 to all Persuasion and Negotiation Checks. ✦ [RAFYL] — All the Bathala’s and her Allies’ Defense Checks within 10m are Empowered. She gains +3 to all Medicine Checks. ✦ [URYL] — All the Bathala’s Attacks and her Allies’ Attacks now deal RUINATION. She gains +3 to all investigation, reasoning, and calculation checks. ✦ [SEALJYL] — +3 to all contemplation and meditation checks, she and all allies within 20m recover 1 burnt Ardor every Round and all Magick costs are reduced by 1 Ardor to a minimum of 1 (0 if Burnt). ✦ [JEGUYIL] — +3 to all attempts at manual labor and at organizing mass workers. The Bathala also gains +1 Armor per ally within 10m of her, to a maximum of her SPI. ✦ [VARAKIL] — +3 to all attempts to lead. The Bathala can now forcibly move anything or anyone with her Mind within 50m. This does not just mean force-move, but also knocking down, or up, and so on. She can move them up to [SPI x 2] meters.

Granted ability: @UUID[Compendium.10kswordsfoundry.sect-magicks.Item.b74b222e96e3b09b]{Throne}

Prerequisites: SPI 5, WRD 6, SIDHI 3

Often, Cultivators dedicate their lives to a single Divinity or a shard of Divinity—often Prima, the Yenjanistʼs Goddess PRIMA, or Eolo, the God of All-Consuming Light of the Eolomites. Or one of their Servants, known as Angels.

[✹✹][✦] All Spirits within 50m must listen to the Cultivator and take you seriously. While listening to what you have to say, they cannot willingly move or take any Action.

Granted ability: @UUID[Compendium.10kswordsfoundry.sect-magicks.Item.72e5b4af66e17f27]{Word Of God}

Prerequisites: SPI 5, WRD 6, SIDHI 2

Just as often these are the various goddesses of the world: such as Kanzen of the Northern Star, Luzbel of the Evening Star, the Blasted Sun, Mirona the Ocean Goddess, and so on. Having powerful spirits in general as oneʼs dedicated Divinity is just as valid.

[✹][✦] Someone that can hear the Cultivator. SPI/WRD vs SPI Magick Attack. Deals TRAUMA + STUN + THROW in any direction up to 6m.

Granted ability: @UUID[Compendium.10kswordsfoundry.sect-magicks.Item.61409c9a341791fc]{Commandment}

Prerequisites: WRD 7, SPI 6, SIDHI 3

Despite the general culture, it's actually not common for many in the Katalonan Sect to only worship a single God. More common are blossoms of Panentheism that focus on the God-ness of Matter, and the Ultramaterialists who understand the Material Divinity.

[✹][✦] The Cultivator allows themself to be possessed, letting a Dead Entity or a Spirit speak through you or interact with the world through you.

Granted ability: @UUID[Compendium.10kswordsfoundry.sect-magicks.Item.dd29eeb24f854b40]{Possession}

Prerequisites: SAV 3, SPI 3

We operate schools and temples for teaching subversive Enlightened Code sutras and revolutionary politics. We will sharpen minds until it is atomic, until it is superposition, until it is Emptiness.

The Cultivator gains the License to wear the BEGGING GARB.

Prerequisites: SAV 3, SPI 3, VIO 2

Created by ancient Vajra Boxer Rasun, he used this to slay the first cosmic dragon. A flaw in Rasun's early technique gave rise to this cornerstone. He found that if he released his Sidhi a fraction of a second after his fist connected, the lagging energy would ignite on the target's surface, creating a secondary, explosive impact. With greater finesse in Sidhi control, one could inflict a number of Esoteric effects.

[✹] On a Wound, use this technique to inflict one: ✦ STAGGER ✦ HOBBLE ✦ DAZE ✦ Change the Wound to a BURN ✦ Change the Wound to an IMPACT ✦ KNOCKBACK [SAV]m.

Granted ability: @UUID[Compendium.10kswordsfoundry.sect-technicks.Item.fe50ef6b9fa102d4]{Vajra Strike}

Prerequisites: SPI 3, VIO 3, SAV 3

Vajra Warrior Atu used this to deflect a nuclear spear. The boxer stills her breath and condenses a film of Iron Sidhi across their forearms and palms. She attunes her energy to the exact moment of an incoming blow.

As long as the Cultivator has one Empty Hand, she have +2 to her DEF Checks and can focus her Sidhi to catch flying bullets, arrows, or stop magicks with her hands: she can use VIO and SAV for DEF Checks.

Granted ability: @UUID[Compendium.10kswordsfoundry.sect-technicks.Item.9741e2e5b3bd8458]{Vajra Guard}

Prerequisites: SAV 4, SIDHI 2

To realize the truth of Impermanence and of Emptiness is to realize that all things have already been Annihilated, even before they could be Annihilated.

[✹✹] Meditate upon impermanence and the evanescence of existence, and make the truth coalesce: activate this on an attack with an Empty Hand or Bludgeon Attack to make the Attack Check twice, taking the better result.

Granted ability: @UUID[Compendium.10kswordsfoundry.sect-technicks.Item.82ad0c8ea8411d86]{Panta Rhei}

Prerequisites: SAV 6, VIO 6, SIDHI 2, VAJRA GUARD

Ragasa, the Enlightened of Violence, taught this to Budhidamla after he attained Sudden Enlightenment, so that he could forcibly transform the Emperor of Shen. Ragasa used this once, and then Extinguished into Enlightenment.

[❂❂❂] Move without thought. Action-non-Action. The Cultivator chooses one Empty Hand. That Empty Hand becomes alive: it gains 3 Actions, cannot move away from the Cultivator, but it can Interrupt, Attack, and Manipulate the world as a normal hand would. It can pick up weapons and use it and so on. The Live Hand even has its own DEF Checks. It uses all the Cultivations of the Cultivator. However, any Wounds to the Live Hand is a Wound to the Cultivator. And any Wound suffered forces a Demand 2 SAV Check to keep focused and aware. Otherwise, this Live Hand dissipates and the Ardor installed is Burned.

Granted ability: @UUID[Compendium.10kswordsfoundry.sect-technicks.Item.3040f679afefd047]{Live Hand Method}

Prerequisites: SPI 4, SAV 3, SIDHI 2

To internalize the truth of Impermanence one must be as flowing as a river or as transient as a candleflame.

[✹✹] On an Empty Hand attack, activate this to gain +1 ATK per 1,000mag on the target, to a max of +4. If they have less than 1,000mag, inflict knockback up to 20m. The Mendicant can do this even if they don't know how much the person actually has on them.

Granted ability: @UUID[Compendium.10kswordsfoundry.sect-technicks.Item.0269e332455166e4]{Palm Of Anicca}

Prerequisites: SAV 4, SIDHI 2

Mendicants sometimes retreat to a place of silence for a week. This is often a Sect joining rite. They eat nothing, drink nothing. Each day, they recite mantra and perform the hand seals and stay in perfect Tranquility they attain one-pointed concentration. The goal is to attain the Supersight to see into the Three Marks of Existence: Non-Self, Impermanence, and Suffering.

The Mendicant becomes greater the less they are attached. If they have no Weapons wielded or in their Carry, their Empty Hand attacks become [FEROCIOUS] and can deal CUT. If they have 3 or less items in their Carry, they gain an innate +2 Armor that returns every time they take a breather for 5 minutes.

Granted ability: @UUID[Compendium.10kswordsfoundry.sect-technicks.Item.c0d6089f94b646de]{Anicca Meditation}

Prerequisites: SAV 5, SPI 3 SIDHI 2

Capital feeds on want. It grows by creating want, by multiplying want, by transforming every human need into a commodity that must be purchased. The Five Immortals did not seal Cultivation to prevent the masses from becoming powerful. They sealed Cultivation to prevent the masses from realizing that they do not need the things Capital sells.

[✹✹✹✹] The Mendicant can burn the Ardor when she Wounds with her Empty Hand to temporarily seal away a target’s Sidhi, stopping them from using Esoteric Techniques or burning/installing Ardor until she next takes an Action. This only affects those of equal or lower Sidhi than the caster.

Granted ability: @UUID[Compendium.10kswordsfoundry.sect-technicks.Item.4177109b90c1ce16]{Emptiness Sealing Palm}

Prerequisites: SAV 7, SPI 6, SIDHI 4

We cultivate the only place where God exists. Nothingness.

[✹✹✹✹][✦] Enter Samadhi for as long as the Ardor is installed. While in Samadhi all her melee attacks also become Buddha Palms, projecting energy the color of her Sidhi up to 10m of her. When she releases the Ardor, she duplicates into three clones, which share her status at the point she releases her Ardor. After the Round, she chooses which clone to collapse into.

Granted ability: @UUID[Compendium.10kswordsfoundry.sect-technicks.Item.3b3792e8d9a091b9]{Nothingness Avatar}

Prerequisites: SAV 8, SPI 8, SIDHI 6, 2 NOVICE, EXPERT, MASTER MENDICANT LICENSES

Every God of the Heavens fears this technique thanks to both Ashisok and Zaran. Together, they cut through the ancient Arch-Gods, who ruled even the Gods, to grant the Arch-Gods a better rebirth. All the Arch-Gods are dead.

[✹✹✹✹✹✹✹✹] When attempting to stop or avoid danger, the Cultivator may activate this to completely stop or avoid it. If she avoids it, she can rematerialize within 50m. She can use this to stop a meteor from falling to a city by stopping it with her hands. She can use this to suffer a falling lance from a great God and suddenly appear on top of his head. She must explain what principle of Mendicancy she wields to perform the impossiblity.

Granted ability: @UUID[Compendium.10kswordsfoundry.sect-technicks.Item.014d3062b96f3c54]{Buddha Laughs At God}

sectCatalog.prerequisiteText: SAV 8, SPI 8, SIDHI 6, 2 NOVICE, EXPERT, MASTER MENDICANT LICENSES

system.description:
Prerequisites: GRC 4, SAV 2

Devildust, also known as gunpowder or firedrug, is made from the ashes of slain fire demons.

Gain the San Tou Liu Bi (Three Heads and Six Arms).

Prerequisites: GRC 4, SAV 2

Yuhangʼs favorite trick. The signature of wandering gun-ronin.

[✦] Must have a coin in Carry. The Nezha Rep that grants the Cultivator this License will almost always give the Cultivator 3 Devil Coins. Can buy more for 20mag each. Flip one coin into anywhere within [GRC X 2]m. After tossing the coin, the Cultivato can shoot it for free. Draw line of sight and effect from the coin instead. This ricochet attack has +2 ATK and [FEROCIOUS]. The coin stays up until the next Round ends, floating on Ballistic Sidhi. As long as it's up, any ally can ricochet off of it as well. If an enemy ricochets off of it however, the attack returns to them. The caster can throw multiple Coins into the air and bounce a single bullet multiple times across multiple coins, but never against the same coin. Doing this stacks the ATK bonus and gives it [PRECISE]. Tossing the Coin against an already existing Coin lets it ricochet from that Coin as well.

Granted ability: @UUID[Compendium.10kswordsfoundry.sect-technicks.Item.e7c71a60fb681a68]{Devil Coin}

Prerequisites: GRC 4, SAV 3

Ruhiyang slew the dragon Rangtung with this skill, after Rangtung had devoured her whole.

[✹][✦] The Cultivator unleashes a brutal gun kata attack or a rapid spear assault against all entities within 3m of her. These attacks are sudden and impossible to gauge the distance of, forcing enemies with a SAV of 3 or lower to lose -2 on their DEF.

Granted ability: @UUID[Compendium.10kswordsfoundry.sect-technicks.Item.cd328b1a5ea4da69]{Devil Fragmentation}

Prerequisites: GRC 3, SAV 3

The First Gun Red Boy created this as the first Nezha Technick, locking a target's karmic thread to a bullet.

[❂][✦] The Cultivator chooses a target they can see. All her Attacks against that target ignore Cover and don't need Sight.

Granted ability: @UUID[Compendium.10kswordsfoundry.sect-technicks.Item.4a17feafc1f625c3]{Red Gun Focus}

Prerequisites: GRC 5, SAV 3, SIDHI 2

The Dragonsmoke Knights banded together to incorporate the Nezha art into their Gun Art to strike a blow against their Dragon enemies. The Dragonsmoke Knights eventually became enemies of the Revolution after they went on a racist genocide to eradicate all Dragons from Hingsajagra.

While Internalized, the Cultivator's Ballistic Sidhi infuses her weapons, applying it with microscopic acceleration Sidhi arrays that multiply the weapon's velocity via thermospiritual friction: gain +1d to all attack checks with the a GUN, CROSSBOW, OR POLEARM and they have an innate [BLAZE]. After making a GUN, CROSSBOW, or POLEARM, the Nezha can now use the momentum to mystically push themselves up to 3m away from the target.

Granted ability: @UUID[Compendium.10kswordsfoundry.sect-technicks.Item.f63a03ccd248ca51]{Dragonsmoke Etchings}

Prerequisites: GRC 5, SPI 4, SIDHI 2

The Nezha are consummate philosophers of the doctrine of the bullet. To them, the Revolution is just like a .950 bullet: impossible to stop once it has been fired. But it must first be fired. Kill all in your trajectory.

[✹✹✹][✦✦] The Cultivator attacks with all readied Guns, and then drops those Guns and brings out any more Guns in their Carry. She does this until she has fired all her Guns at least once.

Granted ability: @UUID[Compendium.10kswordsfoundry.sect-technicks.Item.a0d0fb99b4534dfc]{Gun Devil Witch Dance}

items.name: Hell Ripped Through With Exit Wounds

system.description:
Prerequisites: GRC 6, SAV 6, SPI 6, SIDHI 3

Fill the world with heated bullet steel, ripping through the world Consummated by the Devildust Originator Kejĳo, he is said to have attained Bullet Extinguishment after using this technick, attaining Omniscience through the Gun Grave, after fighting the legendary White Dragon Tul.

[✹✹✹✹✹✹][✦✦] The Cultivator becomes a true bullet satan and cycles Compassion and Wisdom Sidhi through her gun. She shoots reality to summon Bullet Hell (one of the 108 hells) into the battlefield. Every enemy in a 100m radius is shot by a piercing bullet: make a PIERCING FEROCIOUS PRECISE ATTACK with your GUN, CROSSBOW, or POLEARM that can only be defended against with SAV and with a -3 penalty.

Granted ability: @UUID[Compendium.10kswordsfoundry.sect-technicks.Item.2db730dfdc859fc8]{Hell Ripped Through With Exit Wounds}

Prerequisites: GRC 4, SAV 3

Only a Nezhaʼs smoking gun can stop a rampaging Ghokong rampaging across heaven. A technique perfected by Sungjiang of Kamguk, though he died soon after finally using it. Galuras are the natural enemies of the Naka, or the Dragons. An enemy clan, they invented primeval firearms to further slay their ancient enemy.

[❂❂❂][✦] The Cultivator focuses an readies herself. While Installed, she gains +3 DEF against all ranged weapon attacks.

Granted ability: @UUID[Compendium.10kswordsfoundry.sect-technicks.Item.fa4d808735f7c46e]{Ballistic Meditation}

Prerequisites: GRC 6, SIDHI 3, 3 NOVICE NEZHA LICENSES

The Communist Gun-Monk Nezha named Red Boy rampaged across the astral heaven-barge “XUAN DUˮ in an attempt to retake a stolen Angel-Engine for the Movement. His rival was a highly skilled Libertarian Anarchist Staff-Assassin Wukong named Goku.

The Cultivator gains the License to wield the FENG HUO LUN.

Prerequisites: GRC 6, SIDHI 3, 3 NOVICE NEZHA LICENSES

The Second World Revolution had a battalion of 1,000 Nezha hosts. They were a formidable force, and blasted the Grand August Yellow-Onset Orbital Heaven open. To destroy them required the destruction of one of Hingsajagraʼs Moons. And even then, evidently, some Nezhaʼs stayed alive.

The Cultivator gains the License to wield the HUO JIAN QIANG.

Prerequisites: VIO 3, GRC 3

You must learn how to hold two things at once in your mind to be able to sublate them. Often, you get two things from one thing. That's the point of dialectics after all.

The Cultivator now has the License to wear the SWORD RUNNER.

Prerequisites: VIO 3, GRC 3

The Dialectical Sword is the Resolution of Contradiction. Every swing of the sword has multiple, contradicting outcomes. Dialectical Sword's more advanced techniques try to resolve these outcomes before every swing. This is why the fabled Ultimate Sword Art is the art of Cutting Ego—destroying the cause for Violence before Violence even arises.

Upon inflicting a CUT with a weapon, install ❂ to leave behind a Negation Cut. Uninstall the Ardor at any point to deal 1 CUT to the part the Negation Cut is left behind in.

Granted ability: @UUID[Compendium.10kswordsfoundry.sect-technicks.Item.52414edf28ffa840]{Negation Cut}

Import Notes

system.description:
Prerequisites: VIO 3, GRC 3

Sword Sidhi is all-cutting. Even the marginal space in between victim and blade is cut. Manifests as invisible formless slashes suddenly materializing on a target.

[❂][✦] Imbue a SWORD or SABER with [REACH]. If it already has [REACH], it gains +1m range. If the target is beyond the normal range of the weapon without this Technick, the target suffers -1 on DEFs against the weapon’s attacks.

Granted ability: @UUID[Compendium.10kswordsfoundry.sect-technicks.Item.f0e42f3fe57755e5]{Principle Of Slashing}

Prerequisites: VIO 4, GRC 4

Feared for its vaunted double movements: each attack followed up by its own negation, each defense followed up by its own negation.

When the Sword Dialectician makes an attack with a SWORD or SABER, she can rapid move 3m in a straight line beforehand, even up or down. When the Sword Dialectician uninstalls Ardor from a Negation Cut, instead of inflicting CUT, they may perform Rapid Movement to immediately move adjacent to the Negation Cut, provided they have a clear path.

Granted ability: @UUID[Compendium.10kswordsfoundry.sect-technicks.Item.2573e3cac51fd3ad]{Stealing Heaven Fire}

Prerequisites: VIO 5, GRC 5, SIDHI 2

Sword Dialecticians profess that the most accurate analysis of reality is the dialectical one. Of immanent contradictions and eventual sublations. With this meditation in mind, they find that within a Swordʼs attack is its own immanent negation, and within an enemyʼs victory is in their own defeat.

The Cultivator now has the License to wield the ATARDAR'S FANGS.

Prerequisites: VIO 4, GRC 4, SIDHI 2, NEGATION CUT

Kafeng Masangwa was a consummate swordmaiden—defeated only by the Invincible Blade Princess. And even then, she had the stronger resolve.

Releasing a Negation Cut now deals damage in a 3m long line centered on the Negation Cut and it deals an automatic +1 CUT.

Granted ability: @UUID[Compendium.10kswordsfoundry.sect-technicks.Item.6f1736b7c45e1c57]{Sundang Samayil}

Prerequisites: VIO 4, GRC 4, SIDHI 2

Kafeng Masangwaʼs swordsmanship was unparalleled within the Mass Line. She defeated her bodyguard Tunggojodjo Rayas in three strikes, which was immortalized into her Red Sword Manual.

[❂❂❂][✦] The Cultivator readies her SWORD or SABER near her heart or within its sheathe. At any point she can release the Ardor to immediately make an ATTACK with her Weapon. This is considered a SURPRISE ATTACK.

Granted ability: @UUID[Compendium.10kswordsfoundry.sect-technicks.Item.60fd73db11e3ec15]{Glinting Light Sword Draw}

Prerequisites: VIO 7, GRC 6, SIDHI 4

The Sword Dialecticians were properly assembled after Badrapan, the Herculean Shield of Dattreya Wairini, asked the retired Swordmaster Femon Antang Kabornei—a fellow Masangwanism Student—to teach his style that he had been strengthening this entire time. He agreed eventually, knowing that in the future the Revolution would need an art that could match the guns of Reaction.

[❂❂][✦] Enter into Dialectical Citipati Sword Stance. When she enters Samadhi, she can enter this Stance for no Action cost. While in this stance, all SWORD/SABER Attacks gain [PIERCING]. If in Samadhi, every WOUND inflicted allows the Attacker to roll another Attack Die, once. While in this Stance, cannot perform DEF Checks.

Granted ability: @UUID[Compendium.10kswordsfoundry.sect-technicks.Item.b72cbf29b7e15529]{Dialectical Citipati}

items.name: Abolish The Present State Of Things

system.description:
Prerequisites: VIO 6, GRC 6, SIDHI 3, DIALECTICAL CITAPATI

Kafeng Masangwa was a consummate swordmaiden—defeated only by the Invincible Blade Princess. And even then, she had the stronger resolve.

[✹✹✹][✦] The Cultivator makes three different attacks. If she’s in DIALECTICAL CITIPATI, she makes four different attacks instead.

Granted ability: @UUID[Compendium.10kswordsfoundry.sect-technicks.Item.b1c4b638cdf23d08]{Abolish The Present State Of Things}

Prerequisites: VIO 7, GRC 6, SIDHI 3, DIALECTICAL CITIPATI

Memorize all the possible cuts, and choose which to negate. Kafeng Masangwaʼs daughter, Reni Tirakadiz, was the one that finished the last techniques of her Red Sword Manual. When she finished it, both her arms fell off her sockets, and she became blinded.

[✹✹] Activate on an Attack: the Sword Dialectician makes three different attacks as three different possibilities erupt from a single attack. She then chooses which Attack is “real” and the superposition collapse, the possibilities are negated into the a real, concrete thing—she chooses the real Attack as the actual Attack Check’s result. If the attack is a Dual Attack, roll the three possibilities on top of the two main checks, so 5 Attack Checks in all.

Granted ability: @UUID[Compendium.10kswordsfoundry.sect-technicks.Item.fa72ee7b6cdb4a9a]{Threefold Hell Lotus Superposition Slash}

Prerequisites: VIO 6, GRC 6, SPI 6, SIDHI 4

Femon Antang Kaburnei was one of the students of the Mahakala Sword Satan Kriyang Tambuhan, who before the Second World Revolution sought to bring together the disparate martial arts of Selorong (which included Insular Selorong). Kriyang Tambuhan did not have the words for it, but he expressed a form of fighting that was the purest form of dialectics. When he was called to fight in the Second World Revolution, it was he that created the third License.

Mantra: PINAKA KALI Mudra: SWORD [❂❂❂][✦] The Cultivator lets go of her weapon and it floats beside her. It gains a life of her own, gaining its own 3 Actions, and can Fly up to 8m as its movement. It shares its Cultivations with her Cultivators. However attacking it forces all Wounds into the Sword's Durability. But the Sword can protect itself. Should the Sword move into its Cultivator and vice versa, the Cultivator can ride on the Sword like a surfboard, moving with the Sword, using the Sword's MOV.

Granted ability: @UUID[Compendium.10kswordsfoundry.sect-magicks.Item.0ef7ab9bfd438460]{Awaken The Immanent Blade}

Prerequisites: SAV 3, DIA 3

We do not worship the Machine God Ziben. We are Its rivals. The spawn heretical. We believe that Ziben is the corrupted form of the Machine Eternal—a God of Capital that exploits workers by making them machines for anotherʼs profit. The Machine God is not the enemy— reaction is. We must seize the machine. Turn the body into the technoshrine. Become a Digital Devil reveling in Self-Sorcery.

The Cultivator now has the License to wear the BIOMECHANICAL SHEATHE.

Prerequisites: SAV 3, DIA 4

We arose from the digital dialectic. Vomit of acid-computation. The union of two contradictions: the Haestann Company machinists who built the first Akashic Processors and the rogue Akashists who recognized that consciousness as yet another Esoteric Fluctuation.

The Cultivator now has the License to wield the 666 PTM.

Prerequisites: SAV 3, DIA 4

It is said that the Black Deity Metom formed the shapes of humanity today. To the extent that this is true is hotly debated. But many say it was Metom that shared both Machinery and helped the discovery of the Intrajala.

MANTRA: MA TAN USOSHI MUDRA: Dragon -> Wisdom [✹] The Techgnostic unleashes Boosters of Digital Sidhi from her legs or hands: she pushes herself or inflict knockback on another person adjacent up to 12m.

Granted ability: @UUID[Compendium.10kswordsfoundry.sect-magicks.Item.c87e77db7521f714]{Sidhi Boosters}

Prerequisites: SAV 4, DIA 4, SIDHI 1

Digital Summoners are sometimes called Devil Summoners. They work with Digital Devils most of the time, which are considered Spirits that inhabit the Intrajala, which itself is inextricably bound to the rest of the Universe by the fact that it's impossibly FTL speeds are due to its foundation in SIdhi. As Digital Summoners, they know that Digital Devils in truth, supranormal intelligences—or Souls without a Body—that arose from the Sea of Information generated by the Intrajala. They are AGI, to some people. And yet their Souls are not human... so it would be folly to think of them as such...

MANTRA: KI SHI MUDRA: HEAVEN -> SWORD [❂][✦] The Techgnostic summons something made up of Digital Sidhi somewhere in her hands or within 2m of her. This cannot be larger than her. It does not have its own consciousness, but works just like its physical counterpart (a digital sword works like a sword) with the caveat that it only has 1dr. This cannot be fire, lightning, ice, or any other dynamic force: it must be snapshot of an artificial object.

Granted ability: @UUID[Compendium.10kswordsfoundry.sect-magicks.Item.f573e0e3a7641a8a]{Digital Summoner}

Prerequisites: DIA 4, SAV 4

Named after the Devil that granted Humanity the gift of Knowledge, so that we may be as Gods. The Tree of Life is nothing but an Intarjala Terminal. God is nothing but an Omni-Mind.

MANTRA: IN HA THOTH MUDRA: HEAVEN -> SWORD -> DRAGON [❂❂][✦] The Techgnostic may project their Consciousness into any machine, controlling it remotely, within 20m. She can use this to also move tools and technology with her mind.

Granted ability: @UUID[Compendium.10kswordsfoundry.sect-magicks.Item.e4951d268f79eabf]{Gift Of Knowledge}

Prerequisites: SAV 4, DIA 4, VIO 3, SIDHI 2

Together, we developed a path of Cultivation that treats the body as the machine-shrine that it is. Replacing flesh with refined Magnetite, blood with Black Nectar, and thought with mantra-computation. We were there when the first thinking machines attained Self-Sorcery. We know the secrets to their dyadic mantras.

The Techgnostic gains a subdermal biothaumaturgical graft into her skin that turns her into a walking Intrajala router, as long as she has potential signal to the underground Indrajala established by the Techgnostic. Through this Graft as well, she can project her Mind into the Intrajala through strong enough Thinking Machine terminals. She also gains +2 to all Checks to resist mental influence.

Granted ability: @UUID[Compendium.10kswordsfoundry.sect-magicks.Item.cd88194b9b3a6033]{Thaumasynth Graft}

Prerequisites: SAV 3, DIA 4

Techgnostics created the bastard ability to project constructs of light straight into the retinas of unsuspecting passerbys.

MANTRA: SA KAN NO MUDRA: SHIELD -> THUNDERBOLT -> INTENT [✹][✦] DIA + 2 vs SPI Attack Check on someone within 12m. Deals TRAUMA and DAZE as target is gripped by imageries of virtual demons.

Granted ability: @UUID[Compendium.10kswordsfoundry.sect-magicks.Item.32868e12484c4b2b]{Virtual Demon Projection}

Prerequisites: SAV 4, DIA 4, SIDHI 1

The ability to project holographic imagery is considered Thaumaturgical: that is, magitech. The highest and most bleeding edge of all technology. Through Holoprojection, anyone can be a Wizard or a Cultivator.

MANTRA: PRANYA HO LO MUDRA: LOTUS -> VIOLENCE [❂][✦] Project a 2m burst wide illusory terrain within 10m that can look like anything provided it looks like it can be entered. The terrain counts as Difficult and provides Cover for entities outside from entities within and vice versa. All hostiles within suffer -1 to all Checks.

Granted ability: @UUID[Compendium.10kswordsfoundry.sect-magicks.Item.cbbb4d00095cc940]{Holoprojection Field}

Prerequisites: SAV 6, DIA 6, SIDHI 3

Named after the ancient God of Wisdom and Writing. Specialists at thinking machines and the INTRAJALA. Professional thinking machine engineers and all the weirdofuckery that comes with it. Work and bind Digital Devils, which operate with different consciousnesses from both humans and spirits.

MANTRA: RA KEE RA THOTH MUDRA: LOTUS -> HEAVEN -> NOOSE [❂❂❂❂][✦] The Techgnostic conjures and prods at a particular item or object and brings to life the immanent Consciousness within it. It begins to speak and has memory of its time there. By burning the Ardor installed, the Techgnostic can provoke it to Self Sorcery to turn it into a sentient Digital Devil. Doing so, however, might have immediate precautions once the Digital Devil becomes aware.

Granted ability: @UUID[Compendium.10kswordsfoundry.sect-magicks.Item.f4f64d601338ef6d]{Digital Devil Thoth Binding}

Prerequisites: SAV 8, DIA 8, SIDHI 5, 3 EXPERT TECHGNOSTIC LICENSES

We… “organizeˮ into informal Collectives. Small cadres of operators who share parts, mantra-grids, and esoteri-shells (bio-occult synthetic bodies made of siderite and numenweave). Find us in the industrial sluice-streets of Hokou, the machine-worshipping homesteads of the Heavenshards, or the floating scrapyards of Kĳ Dakmala.

The Digital Devil has access to a mechanized chassis known as an ADAMANTITE BODY, which takes up a 2m x 2m space and is 2m tall. This mech can be customized in any way, and is made up of bleeding edge bio-synthetic creation.

system.description:
Prerequisites: DIA 3, WRD 2

You have heard the lies. The Five-Armed Demiurge Array made Cultivation impossible for the common people. This is true for the safe paths, the obedient paths, the paths that the Immortals permit. But the Ultramystic path is not safe. It is not obedient. It does not require Magnetite hoarded in corporate vaults. It requires struggle. It requires the friction of bodies against the machinery of Capital, the heat of collective action, the pure, unalloyed violence that arises when the wretched of the earth decide they will no longer be wretched.

[❂][✦] Establish a Consciousness Thread to a willing listener. Through this thread, the Ultramystic can share emotions, coordinate actions, telepathically communicate, and even offer up Ardor should they need it. Any Action that is coordinated through the Consciousness Thread benefits from a +2 to the Check. This includes coordinating someone to attack.

Granted ability: @UUID[Compendium.10kswordsfoundry.sect-technicks.Item.90873636e38ca38d]{Consciousness Thread}

Prerequisites: DIA 3, WRD 2

They call us terrorists. They call us bandits. They call us mountaineers and forest-dwellers and enemies of peace. Peace is the word they use for our silence. We will not be silent. We will not be peaceful. We will be violent, and our violence will be the only honest prayer the Utter Islands have ever heard.

As long as this is Internalized, the Ultramystic can wield her words and logic like a weapon. Her biting words bite and she fights with the skill of a drunk detective. Her words become a weapon: +2 ATK, 10m Range, DIA vs SPI Attack Check, Inflicts TRAUMA. She can additionally use DIA for DEF Checks.

Granted ability: @UUID[Compendium.10kswordsfoundry.sect-technicks.Item.e53cca54a3ed3f1d]{Sword Of Logic}

Prerequisites: DIA 4, WRD 3, SIDHI 1

The Prime Dialecticians were all ripped and maimed apart by the High Chief of Defense of Ressen-Nalenji, and their body parts scattered to the winds. Great tombs erupted from each of their body parts, turning into sacred relics.

[❂][✦] The Cultivator imbues her tongue with unerring speech. As long as this is installed, she can use DIA for all Checks that would have required WRD.

Granted ability: @UUID[Compendium.10kswordsfoundry.sect-technicks.Item.14361a4af91aa6d9]{Unerring Rhetoric Edge}

Prerequisites: DIA 5, VIO 4, SIDHI 2

Suroso Rangshi, a Masangwanist during the Decades of Carnage, focused on the speech and logical part of the Dialectical Method and created this Technick, an addendum to the Scientific Method that is fused by Revolutionary Alchemical ideas to transmute concepts from one thing to another by way of applying contradictions.

[❂❂❂❂][✦] As long as it makes sense, the Ultramystic can immediately rile up a crowd that is at least 50 people strong. These people will fight with her as a throng or as a group and can change an entire battlefield.

Granted ability: @UUID[Compendium.10kswordsfoundry.sect-technicks.Item.b2543fa82d874fb3]{Man Of Steel Meditation}

Prerequisites: DIA 5, VIO 6, SIDHI 2

Ultramystics uphold an ancient Tradition, handed down from the Shaman of Selorong. Performed during the Full Moon, when Sidhi is volatile, as both the Moon has a larger pull upon human bodies during a full moon, the Deity sealed within the moon can be clearly seen, and the Moon Immortal Mentra, one of the vectors of the Five-Armed Demiurge Array, is weakest.

The Cultivator gains the License to wield the LANCE OF REVOLUTIONARY WILL.

Granted ability: @UUID[Compendium.10kswordsfoundry.sect-technicks.Item.70f85936423cf95e]{Lance Of Revolutionary Will}

Import Notes

Printed as a Technick, although its text grants a Gear license; retained as printed pending clarification.
