system.description:
Prerequisites: DIA 4, VIO 3, SIDHI 1

In the Revolutionary Era, the Arch-Revolutionary Kafeng Masangwa attained some modicum of Omniscience by solidifying her materialist doctrine of Scientific Communism. The followers of Masangwa wield the Sword of Dialectics to cut through contradiction and find the ultimate Resolution at the heart of things, which is sublation, which is nonduality.

[✹✹✹][✦] The Cultivator barks out a scything command. Whatever the word is, its power is imbued with Persuasive Sidhi, and all those that hear must stop. All beings of choice by the Cultivator she must make a DIA vs SPI Opposed Check against. On those she wins against, they are Stopped: they cannot move voluntarily and cannot take any Actions. Every 6 seconds that pass, she must make another DIA vs SPI opposed check again. If she wins, they stay stopped. If she loses, they can move.

Granted ability: @UUID[Compendium.10kswordsfoundry.sect-technicks.Item.4ba52e183a3f9b01]{Scythe Of Words}

Prerequisites: DIA 5, VIO 4, SIDHI 2

All deduction is a recursion of reduction. All deduction is the sublation of Contradiction. So deduce, and tell us what you see. The counterbalance to Pessimism of the Intellect. Having accepted the limits of logic, the practitioner now chooses to act. The will, unburdened by the need for perfect certainty, becomes a blazing force.

[✹][✦✦✦] The Cultivator stays and analyzes someone for 6 seconds. Afterwards, they immediately gain a single Leverage and +3 on all Checks against them for an hour. This Leverage must be somehow understandable or deducible from the physical form of the person at that moment.

Granted ability: @UUID[Compendium.10kswordsfoundry.sect-technicks.Item.cbb16d89076ac5d6]{Dialectical Deduction}

Prerequisites: DIA 7, VIO 7, SPI 6 SIDHI 4

It involves collective ingesting of profane substances—sometimes but not always an Elixir of Revolution (made of aborted fetus, semen, menstruation blood, all of past revolutionaries). This is followed by the subsequent cutting of each other, before bathing in a natural hot spring, untouched by Capital.

When an Ultramystic enters a new area, she can immediately ask for a local RIGHT-HAND due to the intensely wide interconnecting network of the Communist Party. The RIGHT-HAND is a whole World Being made like a Wanderer. The Right-Hand will fight alongside her and work with her as much as possible. Should the Ultramystic die, the player can take on the Right-Hand as a new Ultramystic.

Granted ability: @UUID[Compendium.10kswordsfoundry.sect-technicks.Item.7fc3a4d792ca5de1]{Right-Hand Man Arcana}

Prerequisites: DIA 7, VIO 7, SPI 6 SIDHI 4

All things are made up of smaller things. All kings are made strong by their warriors. All warriors are fed by the farmers. In truth, it is the Small that creates the Large. In truth, there can be no Large without the Small. There is no one Great without the Meager. There are no Atoms without Protons. There is no Society without the Human. There is no Bourgeoisie without the Proletariat.

[✹✹✹✹✹][✦✦] The Ultramystic coordinates all her allies in a Fight: she takes a single Uninterruptible Action, and then all her Allies gain +1 Uninterruptible Action on top of their main 3 Actions for the Round.

Granted ability: @UUID[Compendium.10kswordsfoundry.sect-technicks.Item.7b29e2327cd2d7bb]{A World To Win}

Prerequisites: DIA 7, VIO 7, SPI 6 SIDHI 4, RIGHT HAND MAN

THERE IS NO GOD BUT THE PROLETARIAT.

As long as an Ultramystic’s Allies are within 100m of her, she cannot die. If she falls to 0 Health from the violence of an enemy of the Proletariat, she immediately dematerializes and rematerializes adjacent to an ally of her choice. Every death she suffers this way grants her +1 Perversion and +50 XP, and Empowers all her Checks for 10 minutes. If the Ultramystic has a Right Hand, the Ultramystic can choose to die. If she does, the Right Hand gains all her current Licenses and Traits. That Right Hand cannot use this ability.

Granted ability: @UUID[Compendium.10kswordsfoundry.sect-technicks.Item.c2df75b7dcf30dd5]{What Must Be Done}

sectCatalog.prerequisiteText: DIA 7, VIO 7, SPI 6 SIDHI 4, RIGHT HAND MAN

system.description:
Prerequisites: VIO 3, SPI 2

The Wukongs have perfected the art of patience, becoming like mountains, and challenging all to strike them. Like their nameʼs sake, their Sidhi are born from spheres of rock.

When the Wukong deals damage, they can install ❂ to inflict esoteric AGGRAVATION on the target. They find it difficult to attack others—they suffer -2 on all Attacks that don’t include the Wukong as a target. Any Aggravated entity that leaves the melee weapon range of the Wukong suffers 1 IMPACT ATTACK DIE FROM THE WUKONG.

Granted ability: @UUID[Compendium.10kswordsfoundry.sect-technicks.Item.695775db7b8214aa]{Mock Heaven}

Import Notes

Conditional or prose costs remain in the description; check the trigger and spend resources as described.

system.description:
Prerequisites: VIO 4

To strengthen oneʼs body beyond its limits is to eat the face of god. Spit it out, donʼt swallow. See? Youʼve eaten yourself. This is the Ego Beyond Ego. Otherwise known as the God Beyond God. At the core of the Vajra Sutra is nothing but Emptiness. So remember to spit It out.

[❂][✦] Imbue a BLUDGEON or CLEAVER with powerful striking Sidhi. The weapon now knocks back up to 6m. Any Collision from this inflicts +1 Wound. Every Strike against an Object generates two Wounds instead of one.

Granted ability: @UUID[Compendium.10kswordsfoundry.sect-technicks.Item.bf0bf0b14d67bb8a]{Great Sage Club}

Prerequisites: VIO 3, SPI 2

Yaohou means Monster or Demon Monkey. It was an insult to the great Bhante, but for us, it is a proof of our capability. Abandon all hesitation: there is no greater monster than you.

The Cultivator gains the license to wear the GOLDEN CHAINMAIL SHIRT.

Prerequisites: SPI 5, VIO 4, SIDHI 2

The Wukong Sect was established to create a Cultivator that could raid the Orbital Heavens and steal away their the vaunted Peaches of Immortality which held immense amounts of Sidhi within them. Huowang means Monkey King.

MANTRA: SAMA DHI SKAN DHA MUDRA: DRAGON [✹✹ + ❂][✦] Immobilize someone within 10m: they cannot move voluntarily but they can still perform actions. If they are of higher Sidhi, the Cultivator must win a VIO vs SPI Opposed Check first. The immobilized lasts for as long as the Ardor is installed.

Granted ability: @UUID[Compendium.10kswordsfoundry.sect-magicks.Item.deac630d7c8d0fff]{Body-Fixing Method}

Prerequisites: VIO 4, GRC 4, SIDHI 1

The Archeprimeval inspiration for the Sect was said to have traveled to Heaven and pissed everyone off. Worse, even the greatest philosopher of that era could not contain him in mystic Samadhi Fire. Only the highest intelligence—a human that attained Enlightenment—could contain the Mind Monkey.

[✹✹][✦] Leap 3m in any direction and then make a weapon attack. This leap removes STUN, STAGGER, and HOBBLE. If this leap was used as an Interrupt to avoid an attack, the leap automatically succeeds without needing an Opposed Check. Then, the Attack is empowered and becomes [CRUSHING] and [FEROCIOUS].

Granted ability: @UUID[Compendium.10kswordsfoundry.sect-technicks.Item.7691c1ad9d73233e]{Rebuff The Jade Emperor}

Prerequisites: SPI 4, VIO 4, SIDHI 1

Not just a metaphor. With just an incantation, the Wukongs are able to emulate the actions of the hallowed Bhante, turning into stone and becoming impervious to all things.

MANTRA: TAMRA SIRSA LOHA PADA MUDRA: SWORD [✹ + ❂❂❂] The Cultivator suddenly turns her body into solid rock: she become impervious to all Wounds and cannot be moved. However, she also cannot perform any Actions, cannot move, and is effectively asleep. She can end the Magick at any time by releasing the Ardor. Any entity that strikes her solid rock form is STAGGERED and STUNNED.

Granted ability: @UUID[Compendium.10kswordsfoundry.sect-magicks.Item.58d9158838274d3b]{Copper Head Iron Limbs}

Prerequisites: VIO 5, GRC 7, SIDHI 4

“To be indestructible is not a matter of hardness, but of pliability. We Wukongs have leapt to the ends of the Trichiliocosm and learned from the Great Primeval Buddha the truth of defense and protection.ˮ — SIX-ARMED THREE HEADED ASURA ARHAT

[✹ + ❂❂❂][✦] The Cultivator cloud somersaults up to 5m in any direction. A clone of herself stays at the point where she left. When she takes an Action, she can choose which Clone on the field takes the Action. She can burn burn the installed Ardor on a Clone to make them perform an Action at any point (which means they can use this as an Interrupt).

Granted ability: @UUID[Compendium.10kswordsfoundry.sect-technicks.Item.3cf19f594181a095]{Pluck Of Many}

Prerequisites: VIO 8, SPI 8, SIDHI 5

At journey's end, the great Wukong, having attained Enlightenment, became the Victorious Fighting Buddha, escaping finally from the world as an Enlightened One. His tales became beacons of inspiration for the great revolutionaries of our time, especially Kafeng Masangwa, who sought to also attain Enlightenment Through Violence.

MANTRA: QI TIAN DA SHENG MUDRA: HEAVEN -> EARTH -> MAN -> THUNDERBOLT -> LOTUS -> THUNDERBOLT -> WISDOM [✹✹✹ + ❂❂❂][✦✦] The Cultivator grows up to Size 2, so does her Gear. She makes a VIO vs SPI check against all hostiles that can see her. Those that lose against cannot see anyone but her, and are filled with an unexplainable fury for as long as the Ardor is installed. While in this form, the Cultivator's Weapon Attacks become innately [CRUSHING] and [UNBLOCKABLE].

Granted ability: @UUID[Compendium.10kswordsfoundry.sect-magicks.Item.272ac3969b205dc9]{Great Sage Equal To Heaven}

Prerequisites: SPI 3, WRD 2, SAV 2

Exorcists are integral to the Revolutionary Army: the Forces of Reaction and Liberalism wield the Spirits the geists to strengthen their forces and fight back against revolutionary mysticks and wizards. A way to bind these entities is imperative. Thus why in the rebuilding of the Communist Party it became imperative to establish the Zhongkui Sect.

MANTRA PARTITION MUDRA SWORD [❂][✦] The Zhongkui creates an up to 10m long straight line anywhere on a solid surface. Spirits cannot cross these Partitions. For sentient beings these become low-hazy light walls that can be used as cover and is Difficult Terrain to move through. If placed upon an object, the Zhongkui turns that object into an anathema to Spirits. Spirits fall away from the item, and using it as a weapon imbues that weapon with the [HOLY] property.

Granted ability: @UUID[Compendium.10kswordsfoundry.sect-magicks.Item.058fe484ce02d690]{Partition}

Prerequisites: SPI 3, WRD 2, SAV 2

The oldest exorcist magick, taught by the spiritworkers and shamans of the old world. The world is the world of spirits, not of man. May we all attain concordance with Void.

MANTRA ANG MANG SANG MUDRA WISDOM [✹][✦] A binding mudra: WRD vs SPI Attack Check. 20m range. TRAUMATIZES and STUNS upon wounding. If the target is a Spirit, the Zhongkui can also install ❂ to Seal them into an object or another person. Sealing a Spirit into another person risks Consciousness Violence, so it is safer to put them into an object with a subtler Consciousness. Zhongkui can Seal spirits to themselves by losing 2 max Health. While Sealed, the Spirit knows it is the Zhongkui that sealed them, and will act accordingly. The object that the Spirit inhabits will exhibit the Spirit’s features—a Fire Demon might cast an object on fire, while a poltergeist might inflict Knockback. A Zhongkui with a sealed Spirit can call upon the Spirit’s special abilities.

Granted ability: @UUID[Compendium.10kswordsfoundry.sect-magicks.Item.ce6065feb78fdbba]{Binding}

Prerequisites: SPI 3, WRD 2, SAV 2

The Sacred Exorcist of Siyucheng, while in service to the Lucent Immortal Ri Sogaha, took a portion of the Lucent Immortals' semen and set it alight with Divine Fire. Through this ritual she gleaned the Enlightenment needed to subjugate even Deities.

The Cultivator gains the License to wield the DHARMA ROBE.

Prerequisites: SPI 3, WRD 2, SAV 2

Crafted by the lowly soil Exorcist Perangsis, in an attempt to bind a Fox Immortal to become his wife. Perangsis has never been seen ever since.

The Cultivator gains the License to wield the SPECTRAL SEAL TALISMAN. She gets 3 to begin with upon approval of Licensure.

Prerequisites: SPI 5, WRD 3, SIDHI 3

A technique created by the Devil Immortal Exorcist Yazatram of the Rutilant Coven, at first, to strengthen himself. Later, when he was transformed by an Enlightened One, she chose to teach the Rite for good.

[✹+❂❂][✦] The Zhongkui must reach out and physically consume a spirit within 1m, devouring their essence completely. This kills the spirit, but heals the Zhongkui by Health Levels equal to the target's Sidhi. After consuming, the Zhongkui enters Samadhi.

Granted ability: @UUID[Compendium.10kswordsfoundry.sect-technicks.Item.1c970b019839b5bd]{Goetia Devouring}

Prerequisites: SPI 5, WRD 4, SIDHI 2

Nature Gods are trickier. These are emergent informational patterns that arise from the dialectical movement of an ecosystem powered by Sidhi that sometimes inhabit an animal, or cobble together a coherent, mythic form. Appeasing these requires tapping into informational resonances, a form of mystic science that the ancestors had a sensitivity to through application of symbol. It's much less complicated to just eat them all.

ANTRA NALA PURA MUDRA WISDOM -> DRAGON -> THUNDERBOLT [✹✹✹][✦] 10m blast cone. WRD+2 vs SPI Attack. HOLY. BURNS. But against Spirits, RUINATIONS.

Granted ability: @UUID[Compendium.10kswordsfoundry.sect-magicks.Item.04033e955c24cc9c]{Holy Exorcist Fire}

Prerequisites: SPI 4, WRD 4, SIDHI 1

A magick perfectly formulated by the Angel Spirit King Tattanzon of Woeʼs Fissure. She used it to find her wife in the Akasha, where ghosts dwell. She found nothing but truth.

ANTRA PANA HA MUDRA HEAVEN -> MAN -> EARTH -> SWORD [✹ + ❂][✦] Drop some blood from the target or flowers from the target's grave. The blood or petals stay in the air and then snake towards the target being found. The trail lasts for as long as the Ardor is Installed.

Granted ability: @UUID[Compendium.10kswordsfoundry.sect-magicks.Item.c78918a1c56e29f7]{Spirit Seeking Thread}

Prerequisites: SPI 3, WRD 4, PARTITION

“Spiritˮ is a wide designation used to refer to a whole slew of Esoteric beings: ghosts (persistent information of dead sentient beings that linger), demons (entities structured by malevolent information patterns given life by Sidhi) and the undead (corpses reanimated by an outer force).

MANTRA WAY U SOG MUDRA HEAVEN -> SWORD -> DRAGON [✹+❂❂❂][✦] The Zhongkui can now tie the Partition around an entity: they can choose up to 4 entities within 20m. The Bound cannot move from their point in space until the Ardor is released. If the target is of equal or higher Sidhi Level, this requires an opposed WRD vs SPI Check.

Granted ability: @UUID[Compendium.10kswordsfoundry.sect-magicks.Item.1eb41ec71318cbd3]{High Spirit Bind}

Prerequisites: WRD 3, SPI 4, BIND

Unbeknownst to you, your soul has a hundred hands, and some of them arenʼt yours. Some say Sorcery is connected to the avernal energies of the deeper and greater Consciousness, the Ego that arises from Self-Grasping.

MANTRA JI MUDRA WISDOM [✹+❂][✦] The Cultivator can move an entity within 20m up to [DIA + SPI]m in any direction telekinetically. Against Unwilling Entities, win a SPI vs SPI Check.

Granted ability: @UUID[Compendium.10kswordsfoundry.sect-magicks.Item.1ce852a164a5e723]{Ghost Hand Seal}

Prerequisites: SPI 5, WRD 3, SIDHI 3

Appeasing Spirits requires tapping into informational resonances, a form of mystic science that the ancestors had a sensitivity to through application of symbol.

The Cultivator gains the License to wield the DEMON SUBJUGATING SWORD.

Prerequisites: SPI 5, WRD 3, SIDHI 3

Seek the old fires. Rekindle the broken pyres. Encircle the shadowed vessel. To bind one to another's desires. A litany sung by the Old Exorcists. It is the destiny of exorcists to either become Immortal… or turn into the very Ghost and Demons they banish and ward. The greatest of Zhongkui—the Shaman Kings— threaten the very Heavens themselves.

The Zhongkui’s very presence is a mark of subjugates, like ancient Padmasambhava subduing the demons of the Ceiling of the World. All Spirits and any entity’s suffering Conditions or Diseases within 10m of the Zhongkui suffer -2 to all Checks they attempt. The Cultivator gains the License to wield the FIVE THUNDER JAPAMALA.

Import Notes

The printed heading repeats Demon Subjugating Sword; this license is named for the Five Thunder Japamala explicitly granted in its text (p.185).
